item.title: Andrea Bricco - Ozark Radio News
item.description: Andrea Bricco, 57, of Salem, Arkansas, passed away on Monday, November 24, 2025, in Mountain Home, Arkansas. She was born on October 13, 1968, in Denver, Colorado, to Gordon and Kathy (Hawkins) Bricco. Andrea worked as a scheduler for Baxter Regional Medical Center, where she was known for her dedication, warmth, and strong work ethic. […]
